faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for KSSM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 17 November 2026, and candidates report at 9:30 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in KSSM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 16 vacancies: 5 Paediatrician / Medical Officer, 3 Clinical Psychologist, 1 Physiotherapist, 4 Occupational Therapist, 2 Audiologist cum Speech Therapist, 1 Developmental Therapist.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for KSSM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 17 November 2026 at 9:30 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.answer: Kerala Social Security Mission Head Office, Poojappura, Thiruvananthapuram.

faq.answer: The maximum age is 56 years (as on 1 January 2026).

faq.answer: It depends on the post: 63,440 for Paediatrician / Medical Officer, 48,550 for Clinical Psychologist, 39,690 for Physiotherapist, 34,180 for Occupational Therapist, 39,690 for Audiologist cum Speech Therapist.
